from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures capital surplus/equity data from a single document filing."""
    registrant_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific accounting term used for the capital surplus (e.g., 'Additional paid-in capital')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for the line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date the reporting period ended")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet containing the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[EquityRecord]
